newFact: A structurally valid simple.patch (129B, 1 file, structuralChecksPass=true, CLI exit 0) still fails buyerCriteria when s121/fixtures/criteria/require-structural.json includes a noteOnly human-review row. Machine rows structural/no-trunc/paths pass; human-review pass=false, so buyerCriteriaSatisfied=false and localBindingSatisfied=false. structuralChecksPass true does not imply buyerAcceptanceVerified true. allChecksPass remains a structural-only alias (allChecksPassScope=structural-packaging-checks-only) and is not escrow. Even when every machine-checkable criterion passes (localBindingSatisfied=true, bindingKind=local), buyerAcceptanceVerified stays false and escrowApproval stays false. Local packager ≠ provider paid run; JSON labels are not buyer escrow acceptance.
